purpose: Research coverage and hypothesis generation only; not a security ranking or deployment recipe.

entries.title: ML-KEM standardized KEM baseline
questions: Which standardized parameter set matches the documented threat model?
Are decapsulation failures and implicit rejection handled exactly as specified?
limitations: No security claim beyond cited standard and reviewed implementation

entries.title: ML-DSA standardized signature baseline
questions: Are signing randomness and deterministic modes configured according to the standard?
Are message/context bindings unambiguous?

entries.title: SLH-DSA hash-based signature baseline
questions: What are the signature-size and performance tradeoffs across standardized parameter sets?
Are domain-separation and address encodings faithfully implemented?
limitations: Do not extrapolate beyond standardized parameter sets

entries.title: Hybrid classical plus PQ KEM composition study
questions: Is the combiner reviewed and domain-separated?
Are transcript binding, downgrade resistance, key confirmation and failure behavior specified?
Can each component's contribution be stated without claiming additive security?
limitations: Concatenation is not assumed secure; no novel combiner promoted

entries.title: Code-based PQC comparative literature study
standards: NIST PQC public standards and reports
questions: Which code families and decoding assumptions are relevant to current standardized candidates?
What are the key-size, bandwidth and implementation tradeoffs?
limitations: Comparative research only; not an endorsement of an unstandardized construction

entries.title: Lattice geometry and module-structure analysis
questions: Which geometric invariants are mathematically relevant to the cited hardness assumptions?
Can assumptions be represented without implying a new reduction?
limitations: Geometric analogy alone provides no cryptographic security evidence

entries.title: Entropy and information-theoretic measurement study
questions: Which entropy notion is being measured and under what distribution?
Are estimates empirical, worst-case, min-entropy, or conditional entropy?
limitations: Large nominal key spaces do not establish effective entropy or security

entries.title: Lean model of protocol composition invariants
questions: Can transcript binding, key separation and state transitions be modeled?
Are assumptions explicit and theorem dependencies audited?
limitations: Formalizing an abstract model does not prove implementation correctness or primitive security

entries.title: Exploratory xenomathematics, glyph and n-ality lens
questions: Can the structures be defined rigorously and related to established algebraic objects?
Is there a precise conjecture with falsifiable consequences?
limitations: Exploratory analogy only; no presumed relevance to cryptographic hardness

entries.title: Time-crystal and dynamical-systems analogy study
questions: Can the proposed structure be represented as a well-defined dynamical system?
Does it yield a theorem or measurable invariant relevant to the stated mathematical question?
limitations: No cryptographic security implication is assumed
